title: Terkini: is this AI answer still true in Malaysia?
meta_description: Terkini checks AI answers about Malaysian rules against official government pages, with exact quotes and a freshness score.
tagline: Checks AI answers about Malaysian rules against official government pages. Every verdict carries the exact quote it rests on.
cases_intro: Six real runs: a model answered a question, then Terkini checked each claim through Tavily on official sites.
own_intro: This page only replays recorded runs: no key, no live calls. To check your own answer, run Terkini on your machine.
own_command:
git clone https://github.com/aimanmalib/terkini && cd terkini
uv run terkini check --pack my "Paste the AI answer here"
own_copy_failed: Could not copy. The commands are selected: copy them by hand.
own_needs: Live checks need your own Tavily key and a Bifrost gateway.
load_failed: The recorded run did not load. Reload the page to try again.
question: Question
summary: {checked} claims checked · {outdated} outdated · {current} current · {unverifiable} not settled
as_of_mixed: Reads as if written before {date} (the dates in it are mixed).
no_source: No official page settled this claim.
legend: Colour shows the verdict on each claim in the answer.
not_advice: Not legal advice. Check the linked official source.
trace_hint: The Tavily and Bifrost requests behind this run
trace_settings_value: topic {topic} · depth {depth}, one retry at {retry} when no official page comes back · max_results {max}
trace_depth_unlogged: search_depth not saved in eval runs
trace_eval_note: Eval runs saved the credits per claim, not each search. The query is the exact string the checker builds from the claim.
trace_fallback_unlogged: fallback not saved in eval runs
trace_gateway_total: {calls} gateway calls · {tokens_in} tokens in · {tokens_out} tokens out
trace_fallbacks: Fallback order sent with each call
trace_spend: Virtual-key spend after the eval run: US${usd}. Bifrost has no price list for these model ids, so token counts are the cost measure.
key_note: The answer key was written from official pages before any model answer was seen (docs/EVAL.md).
outcome_catch: Terkini got this right: the answer is stale, and the official value Terkini found matches the key.
outcome_pass: Terkini got this right: the answer matches the key, and Terkini marked it current.
outcome_catch_partial: Right call, weak evidence: the answer is stale (the key says under RM3 million is exempt, not RM20 million). But the official text Terkini quotes is about the 2025 rollout, so its “Official now” line misses the RM3 million exemption.
outcome_false_alarm: False alarm, kept on purpose: the answer already gives the current 2% rule and calls RM5 and 11% the old rates. Terkini still marked those old rates outdated. It can misread a claim that the answer puts in the past tense.
